body:
Farm babies come only as a BABY or an ADULT. A baby never grows up; it is its own animal (Karolis, 30 Oct). Each baby is shown beside its mother:
- Foal: frisks: little bucks and gallop bursts.
- Lamb: pronks: bounces on four stiff legs.
- Calf: clumsy skip with a rock.
- Piglet: zoomies in circles around its mum.
- Chick: follows the walking hen and pecks.
Stage: 6, Farm Lane.

comments.text: The baby models arrived (foal, lamb, calf, piglet, chick), so this is no longer blocked. Made a baby move for each, beside its mother. No teen stage (your decision). Viewer: no big problems. Minor: the calf's head touches the cow's chin now and then.

make baby chickens run around in flocks as if playing catch. 

but all is GOOD

Done: approved.
Next: queued, not done: chicks run in a little flock, playing catch.
Chicks now run around the hen in a little flock, chasing each other like catch.

short: Babies: foal, lamb, calf, piglet, chicks
